verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs show several many-items-at-once operations. `forget` can remove an entire dataset or run a full cleanup of everything the user can delete. The GitHub integration indexes every repository in an organization. Ingestion takes text, files, or URLs and processes them in one call. However, nothing describes a general batch facility for selecting arbitrary sets of items and applying an operation to them. Missing for 10: explicit batch/multi-item APIs for ingest, update and delete; bulk operations exposed via CLI/MCP; documented limits or performance at scale; independent hands-on corroboration.
